family_sheet.summary: The everyday school office in one place: admissions, student records, fees, attendance, exams, transport, library, communication and more.
family_sheet.problem: Office work is spread across registers, spreadsheets and separate tools, so staff re-enter the same details and answers come slowly.
family_sheet.benefit: Staff could work from one set of records, spend less time compiling reports, and answer parents and leaders faster.
ai: AI-assisted drafting for health notes and admission remarks
Staff can ask questions of school records in plain words
